name: Tenshi ni Chijoku no Senrei o…
source:
Hero almost got run over by a car when he was saved by the goddess of fate Ercione. He becomes an angel and is told to do good deeds, but he actually decided only to make pretty girls feel good by using possessing power he acquired.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角差點被車撞到，被命運女神艾爾西奧涅所救。他變成了天使，被告知要行善，但他只打算利用獲得的附身能力來讓美女們爽。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]］
